reason: The plugin provides an artifact tool and authoring skill for creating, managing, and rendering self-contained HTML documents in an in-app tab, with storage confined to an artifact directory and rendering sandboxed without network or same-origin access.

summaries.zh: 用于创建、管理并在应用内标签页中预览自包含 HTML 文档的智能体工件工具。
summaries.en: An agent artifact tool for creating, managing, and previewing self-contained HTML documents in an in-app tab.

capabilities: Creates, reads, lists, and deletes stored HTML artifacts
Renders stored HTML documents in an in-app sandboxed browser tab
Provides an authoring skill that guides agents to produce self-contained HTML documents
Applies configurable artifact storage and size limits
